errors.evidence: Figure x-axis actually starts from 1994, as mentioned in the reference description as well.

errors.text_span: 尤其是在2015年至2020年期间，发文量显著增加
errors.evidence: While the overall trend is upward, the year 2020 actually shows a significant decrease compared to the surrounding years (2019 and 2021). The true peak and most significant increase occurs in 2021 and 2022.
